note: Family-owned campground on the Chipola River at the SR-71 bridge south of Blountstown, behind a general store and deli. Grass RV sites, plus a bathhouse, tent sites and rustic cabins; boat launch, dock, and canoe/kayak rentals. --Claude
summary: Operator's site and its Park With Us booking page: confirmed $40/night water+electric RV sites (2026-11-10 quote), reservable online, general store. Changed electric 30 -> 50 (two 50-amp sites) and site count 15 -> 10 RV sites. Note trimmed of the price/hookup/booking facts the fields carry. Not stated by the operator: sewer, dump station, showers, season.
flags: Price gate: $40/night base, under US$50 (no gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here).

Water lead (weak): the operator says the campground is 'Located on the Chipola River with boat launch'; entry is 'not waterfront'. Campground-level prose only, no site-level claim - a re-audit lead at most.
